raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

A typo in `--dllm-algorithm-config` can pass unnoticed. For example, LowConfidence accepts `threshhold: 0.8` but still uses the default `threshold` of `0.95`. This PR rejects unknown keys at startup and reports the algorithm and key name.

Related to #39499, Phase 1: reject unknown algorithm configuration keys.

## Modifications

- Check config keys at startup for all four built-in dLLM algorithms.
- Also check keys in Gemma4Renoise's nested config sections.
- Keep existing valid options and defaults. For Gemma4Renoise, a nested value still takes priority when the same option is set at the top level.
- Add CPU regression tests and update the docs.

## Accuracy Tests

The following tests passed in a Linux ARM64 Docker container with Python 3.12.14 and PyTorch 2.13.0+cpu: **52 tests and 62 subtests**, with no skips.

```bash
docker exec sglang-dllm-config-20261014 python -m pytest -v -p no:cacheprovider \
  test/registered/unit/dllm/test_config.py \
  test/registered/unit/dllm/algorithm/test_joint_threshold_indel.py \
  test/registered/unit/dllm/test_gemma4_renoise.py
```

For comparison, the new `test/registered/unit/dllm/test_config.py` was run against the unchanged Python source from base commit `0cf683ea`. All 14 rejection subcases failed because no `ValueError` was raised; all 23 valid-config and default-value subtests passed.

Pre-commit passed for all changed files. `mint validate` also passed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No GPU model accuracy or performance tests were run. This change only validates configuration keys at startup and does not alter model execution, so these benchmarks are not applicable.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with pre-commit.
- [x] Add focused unit tests.
- [x] Update documentation.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmarks (not applicable to this config check).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

         """Apply launch-time constraints owned by an algorithm."""
 
+    @classmethod
+    def validate_config(cls, config: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+        cls._validate_config_keys(
+            config, ("block_size", "capture_input_preparation") + cls.config_keys
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _validate_config_keys(
+        cls,
+        config: dict[str, Any],
+        supported_keys: Tuple[str, ...],
+        *,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        unknown_keys = sorted(
+            f"{prefix}{key}" for key in config if key not in supported_keys
+        )
+        if unknown_keys:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Unknown configuration keys for {cls.__name__}: "
+                + ", ".join(unknown_keys)
+            )
+

         """Return an error for unsupported request features, if any."""

+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import yaml
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase, maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
+
+maybe_stub_sgl_kernel()
+
+from sglang.srt.dllm.algorithm import get_algorithm
+from sglang.srt.dllm.config import DllmConfig
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestDllmConfig(CustomTestCase):
+    def _parse_config(self, algorithm, content):
+        architecture = (
+            "DiffusionGemmaForBlockDiffusion"
+            if algorithm == "Gemma4Renoise"
+            else "LLaDA2MoeModelLM"
+        )
+        model_config = SimpleNamespace(
+            hf_config=SimpleNamespace(
+                architectures=[architecture],
+                delete_token_id=156930,
+                split_token_id=156931,
+            ),
+            vocab_size=157184,
+        )
+        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w", suffix=".yaml") as config_file:
+            if content is not None:
+                config_file.write(content)
+                config_file.flush()
+            server_args = SimpleNamespace(
+                dllm_algorithm=algorithm,
+                dllm_algorithm_config=(
+                    config_file.name if content is not None else None
+                ),
+                model_path="local/diffusion-model",
+                revision=None,
+                max_running_requests=None,
+                dllm_fdfo=False,
+            )
+            with patch(
+                "sglang.srt.dllm.config.ModelConfig.from_server_args",
+                return_value=model_config,
+            ):
+                return DllmConfig.from_server_args(server_args)
+
+    def test_unknown_keys_name_the_selected_algorithm(self):
+        cases = (
+            ("LowConfidence", "threshhold"),  # codespell:ignore threshhold
+            ("JointThreshold", "edit_treshold"),  # codespell:ignore treshold
+            ("JointThresholdInDel", "max_post_edit_step"),
+            ("Gemma4Renoise", "max_denoise_steps"),
+        )
+        for algorithm, key in cases:
+            with self.subTest(algorithm=algorithm):
+                with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as error:
+                    self._parse_config(algorithm, yaml.safe_dump({key: 1}))
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    str(error.exception),
+                    f"Unknown configuration keys for {algorithm}: {key}",
+                )
+
+    def test_keys_from_other_algorithms_are_rejected(self):
+        cases = (
+            ("LowConfidence", "edit_threshold"),
+            ("JointThreshold", "sampler_config"),
+            ("JointThresholdInDel", "penalty_lambda"),
+            ("JointThresholdInDel", "vectorized_decoding"),
+            ("Gemma4Renoise", "threshold"),
+        )
+        for algorithm, key in cases:
+            with self.subTest(algorithm=algorithm, key=key):
+                with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as error:
+                    self._parse_config(algorithm, yaml.safe_dump({key: 1}))
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    str(error.exception),
+                    f"Unknown configuration keys for {algorithm}: {key}",
+                )
+
+    def test_unknown_gemma_keys_include_the_section(self):
+        cases = (
+            ("sampler_config", "entrophy_bound"),  # codespell:ignore entrophy
+            ("temperature_schedule", "min_temperature"),
+            ("stopping_config", "confidence_treshold"),  # codespell:ignore treshold
+        )
+        for section, key in cases:
+            with self.subTest(section=section):
+                with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as error:
+                    self._parse_config(
+                        "Gemma4Renoise", yaml.safe_dump({section: {key: 1}})
+                    )
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    str(error.exception),
+                    f"Unknown configuration keys for Gemma4Renoise: {section}.{key}",
+                )
+
+    def test_mixed_unknown_key_types_report_a_value_error(self):
+        cases = (
+            ("LowConfidence", {7: 1, "extra_option": 2}, "7, extra_option"),
+            (
+                "Gemma4Renoise",
+                {"sampler_config": {7: 1, "extra_option": 2}},
+                "sampler_config.7, sampler_config.extra_option",
+            ),
+        )
+        for algorithm, values, keys in cases:
+            with self.subTest(algorithm=algorithm):
+                with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as error:
+                    self._parse_config(algorithm, yaml.safe_dump(values))
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    str(error.exception),
+                    f"Unknown configuration keys for {algorithm}: {keys}",
+                )
+
+    def test_valid_threshold_configs_reach_the_algorithm(self):
+        cases = (
+            ("LowConfidence", {"threshold": 0.8}),
+            (
+                "JointThreshold",
+                {
+                    "threshold": 0.7,
+                    "edit_threshold": 0.2,
+                    "max_post_edit_steps": 3,
+                    "penalty_lambda": 0.1,
+                    "vectorized_decoding": True,
+                },
+            ),
+            (
+                "JointThresholdInDel",
+                {
+                    "threshold": 0.6,
+                    "edit_threshold": 0.3,
+                    "max_post_edit_steps": 2,
+                },
+            ),
+        )
+        for name, values in cases:
+            with self.subTest(algorithm=name):
+                config = self._parse_config(
+                    name,
+                    yaml.safe_dump(
+                        {
+                            **values,
+                            "block_size": 16,
+                            "capture_input_preparation": False,
+                        }
+                    ),
+                )
+                algorithm = get_algorithm(config)
+                self.assertEqual(config.block_size, 16)
+                self.assertEqual(algorithm.block_size, 16)
+                self.assertEqual(config.mask_id, 156895)
+                self.assertFalse(config.capture_input_preparation)
+                for key, value in values.items():
+                    self.assertEqual(getattr(algorithm, key), value)
+
+    def test_gemma_nested_values_override_flat_aliases(self):
+        config = self._parse_config(
+            "Gemma4Renoise",
+            yaml.safe_dump(
+                {
+                    "block_size": 16,
+                    "capture_input_preparation": False,
+                    "max_denoising_steps": 12,
+                    "seed": 42,
+                    "use_temperature_table": False,
+                    "t_min": 0.1,
+                    "t_max": 0.9,
+                    "confidence_threshold": 0.03,
+                    "stability_threshold": 3,
+                    "sampler_config": {"entropy_bound": 0.2},
+                    "temperature_schedule": {"t_min": 0.3, "t_max": 0.7},
+                    "stopping_config": {
+                        "confidence_threshold": 0.02,
+                        "stability_threshold": 2,
+                    },
+                }
+            ),
+        )
+        algorithm = get_algorithm(config)
+        self.assertEqual(algorithm.block_size, 16)
+        self.assertEqual(algorithm.max_denoising_steps, 12)
+        self.assertEqual(algorithm.seed, 42)
+        self.assertFalse(algorithm.use_temperature_table)
+        self.assertFalse(algorithm.use_graph_input_preparation)
+        self.assertEqual(algorithm.entropy_bound, 0.2)
+        self.assertEqual((algorithm.t_min, algorithm.t_max), (0.3, 0.7))
+        self.assertEqual(algorithm.confidence_threshold, 0.02)
+        self.assertEqual(algorithm.stability_threshold, 2)
+
+    def test_gemma_flat_aliases_remain_fallbacks(self):
+        aliases = {
+            "t_min": 0.2,
+            "t_max": 0.7,
+            "confidence_threshold": 0.03,
+            "stability_threshold": 3,
+        }
+        cases = (
+            ({}, 0.2, 0.03),
+            (
+                {
+                    "temperature_schedule": {"t_min": 0.3},
+                    "stopping_config": {"confidence_threshold": 0.02},
+                },
+                0.3,
+                0.02,
+            ),
+        )
+        for sections, t_min, confidence in cases:
+            with self.subTest(sections=sections):
+                config = self._parse_config(
+                    "Gemma4Renoise", yaml.safe_dump({**aliases, **sections})
+                )
+                algorithm = get_algorithm(config)
+                self.assertEqual((algorithm.t_min, algorithm.t_max), (t_min, 0.7))
+                self.assertEqual(algorithm.confidence_threshold, confidence)
+                self.assertEqual(algorithm.stability_threshold, 3)
+
+    def test_absent_and_empty_yaml_preserve_defaults(self):
+        for name, threshold in (
+            ("LowConfidence", 0.95),
+            ("JointThreshold", 0.5),
+            ("JointThresholdInDel", 0.5),
+            ("Gemma4Renoise", None),
+        ):
+            for content in (None, "", "{}", "# No overrides\n"):
+                with self.subTest(algorithm=name, content=content):
+                    config = self._parse_config(name, content)
+                    algorithm = get_algorithm(config)
+                    self.assertEqual(config.algorithm_config, {})
+                    self.assertEqual(config.max_running_requests, 1)
+                    if threshold is not None:
+                        self.assertEqual(config.block_size, 32)
+                        self.assertEqual(algorithm.threshold, threshold)
+                    else:
+                        self.assertEqual(config.block_size, 256)
+                        self.assertEqual(algorithm.max_denoising_steps, 48)
+                        self.assertEqual(algorithm.entropy_bound, 0.1)
+                        self.assertEqual((algorithm.t_min, algorithm.t_max), (0.4, 0.8))
+                        self.assertTrue(algorithm.use_graph_input_preparation)
+
+    def test_null_gemma_sections_preserve_defaults(self):
+        config = self._parse_config(
+            "Gemma4Renoise",
+            "sampler_config: null\ntemperature_schedule: null\nstopping_config: null\n",
+        )
+        algorithm = get_algorithm(config)
+        self.assertEqual(algorithm.entropy_bound, 0.1)
+        self.assertEqual((algorithm.t_min, algorithm.t_max), (0.4, 0.8))
+        self.assertEqual(algorithm.confidence_threshold, 0.005)
+        self.assertEqual(algorithm.stability_threshold, 1)
+
+    def test_non_mapping_yaml_keeps_the_existing_error(self):
+        for content in ("- threshold\n", "42\n"):
+            with self.subTest(content=content):
+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(
+                    ValueError, "The dLLM algorithm config must be a YAML mapping"
+                ):
+                    self._parse_config("LowConfidence", content)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
